description: Lists every Business Frameworks node: handle, title, layer, token count, price, whether it is free, and whether its decision rule can be run on numbers. Business Frameworks is operating judgement for running a business from launch to about $50M in revenue: value, cash flow, risk (the cost of capital) and growth, down to ten decision rules. Call this first, once, to choose which node answers the question; pass `branch` to see one branch only. Free. Do not use it for businesses above about $50M in revenue, for tax, legal or accounting treatment, or for market data: it holds judgement and rules, not figures about any company.

branch.description: One of: equation, value, cash-flow, risk, growth, decision, market. Omit for the whole catalogue.
